title: Mean of a biased bit
statement: Let $0\leq p\leq 1$, and give the two-point set $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ the probability law assigning mass $1-p$ to $\mathrm{false}$ and mass $p$ to $\mathrm{true}$. The expectation of the indicator that the bit is true is $p$.
